implemented: Direct administrator cancellation of a non-running delegated child uses the same scoped terminal-result helper as worker finalization.
Parent validation and callback participate in the exact cancellation CAS/audit transaction.
RUNNING intent, existing terminal states and replay do not append a callback.
nativeControls: Canonical delegated QUEUED child cancellation retains exactly one parent CANCELLED event and RESULT message.
Repeated request does not duplicate callback; parent RUNNING lease/state are preserved.
Earlier immediate/legacy cancellation, intent-only running cancellation, thrown-claim persistence and26-candidate starvation controls still pass.
limits: Disposable PostgreSQL and synthetic scoped credentials only. No provider, production, external delivery or deployment.
No automatic parent requeue/dependency wake-up or authority change.
Internal helpers are not added to the public package barrel or exposed as callable tools.
